name: Jedaiah
title: Priest after the exile
summary: Jedaiah was a priest among those who returned to Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile. He belonged to one of the prominent priestly families that served in the rebuilt temple. His name is mentioned in several lists of priests and Levites who participated in the rebuilding of Jerusalem and the temple service.

keyEvents.title: Return from exile
keyEvents.description: Jedaiah was among the priests who returned from the Babylonian exile to Jerusalem together with Zerubbabel and Joshua.

keyEvents.title: Listed in the priestly register
keyEvents.description: Jedaiah and his descendants were registered among the priestly families that could prove their genealogy and thus serve in the temple.

keyEvents.title: Service in the temple
keyEvents.description: Jedaiah's family was assigned to the first of the 24 priestly divisions that served in the temple in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Nehemiah's list of priests
keyEvents.description: Jedaja is mentioned among the priests and Levites who returned with Zerubbabel in Nehemiah's record of returning families.

keyEvents.title: Symbolic coronation prophesied by Zechariah
keyEvents.description: The prophet Zechariah mentions Jedaja in connection with a symbolic act where crowns were made and placed as a memorial in the Lord's temple.
